linearization: Coordinator-local RLock serializes automatic admission, pending/final journal and external send/review with shutdown admission_closed persistence and normal-stop start.

focused.action_first: one command or review completes before shutdown close; all later actions 0
focused.shutdown_first: waiting command/tick sends 0, review 0, pause dispatch 0 and journal command none
focused.deadlock: all threads joined within 3 seconds and reentrant callback passed

scope_limit: Linearization is per LifecycleCoordinator instance; multiple simultaneous coordinator instances are excluded by the single runtime owner contract.
